People helped me push my car and I took it to side.

Now the only way was to refill the oil and reach my home, but where do I get oil at this time ?

I looked online on Google Maps to check petrol pumps which are near.

After going throughout a list of 'closed' ones. I found this one saying open till 1am.

I called the number. He told me he was open till 1am and he had oil. I explained my situation and he went out of the way and send a person with the oil cans near my location.

On top of that I had ₹200 less cash for the oil bill. Which I promised him to PayTM. Which I did the next day.

So, I really recommend this outlet and thank the owner for the help and trust.

BTW I was with my wife. So you can understand my situation. When I was stuck.

Thank you.
